# Licensed development fixtures

Downloaded 12 October 2026 for private recognition evaluation. These are not a starter wardrobe or a representative consumer benchmark. `manifest.json` records image checksums and labels established before inference.

- `handmade-shoes.jpg`: AK-Bino, [Handgefertigte Schuhe](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Handgefertigte_Schuhe.jpg), Commons revision 1234306633, [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Original https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f0/Handgefertigte_Schuhe.jpg
- `handbag.jpg`: Saidatul Soleha, [Handbage](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Handbage.jpg), [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Original https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/1b/Handbage.jpg

Official Commons image metadata confirmed the CC0 licenses before download. The historical-dress candidate download was rate-limited and is not present. No claim of testing that candidate is made.
